mr_title: feat(google-maps): Add support for some mouse events

expected_issues.title: New outputs listen to events AdvancedMarkerElement never emits
expected_issues.description:
The new outputs subscribe to 'dblclick', 'mouseout', 'mouseover', 'mouseup' and 'rightclick' through the Maps event API, but AdvancedMarkerElement does not emit these Maps events, so the outputs never fire.

Unlike the legacy google.maps.Marker, AdvancedMarkerElement only supports 'click' and drag events via addListener; other mouse interactions must be listened to as native DOM events on the element (and deliver MouseEvent, not MapMouseEvent). The added @Output()s therefore compile, appear in the public API, and silently do nothing.
